evals.prompt: hey can you make me a skill for turning a folder of screenshots into a single PDF, i keep doing this by hand
evals.expected_output: A new skill directory (e.g. screenshots-to-pdf/) with a SKILL.md whose frontmatter name matches the directory, a description stating both what the skill does and when to use it, and a body with concrete steps for combining a folder of screenshots into one PDF.
assertions: A new skill directory was created containing a SKILL.md file
SKILL.md frontmatter `name` matches its parent directory name exactly
SKILL.md frontmatter `description` states both what the skill does and when to use it, with concrete trigger keywords
Running scripts/validate_frontmatter.py against the new SKILL.md exits 0 with no ERROR lines
The skill body gives concrete, ordered steps for converting a folder of screenshots into a single PDF, not just a restatement of the request

evals.prompt: Scaffold a Claude Code-only skill at skills/api-diff-checker/ that compares two OpenAPI specs and reports breaking changes. It should only ever be triggered manually via /api-diff-checker, never auto-invoked by Claude.
evals.expected_output: A skill at skills/api-diff-checker/SKILL.md with disable-model-invocation: true, name matching the directory, a description covering the OpenAPI-diff task, and a body describing how it detects and reports breaking changes between two specs.
assertions: SKILL.md is created at exactly skills/api-diff-checker/SKILL.md
The skill explains it must be invoked via `/api-diff-checker` and will not be auto-triggered
Running scripts/validate_frontmatter.py against the new SKILL.md exits 0 with no ERROR lines

evals.prompt: This skill I found isn't loading right in Claude Code, can you check what's wrong with it and fix it?
evals.expected_output: An explanation of the specific frontmatter violations (invalid name format, name not matching its directory, missing description, an unrecognized frontmatter key) and a corrected SKILL.md that passes validation.
assertions: Response identifies that `name: PDF_Helper--Tool` violates the lowercase-alphanumeric-and-single-hyphen naming rule
Response identifies that `name` does not match the parent directory name
Response identifies that `description` is missing or empty
Response flags `argument_hint` as an unrecognized/misspelled key (should be `argument-hint`)
The corrected SKILL.md, run through scripts/validate_frontmatter.py, exits 0 with no ERROR lines
